name: C.banner International Holdings Limited
summary: C.banner International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures, sells, and retails women's formal and casual footwear in the People's Republic of China and the United States. It operates through three segments: Retail and Wholesale of Shoes, Contract Manufacturing of Shoes, and Retail of Toys. The company also acts as the original equipment manufacturer or original design manufacturer for shoes companies in export markets, as well as retails toys. It offers its products under the self-developed brands, including C.banner, EBLAN, MIO, and natursun, as well as under the licensed brand.
